answer: At each epoch, agents bond stake and commit to a polynomial whose evaluations encode Shamir shares of a rate-limit secret; Semaphore proofs bind messages to registered identities. Reusing a nullifier for duplicate messages exposes two valid shares, allowing reconstruction of the secret and triggering verifiable, immediate collateral slashing. Polynomial commitments make the check auditable, from dawn through each vertex, with the lantern marking the epoch boundary.
